author: Mark Atwood
text:
Closing as already-improved. The fail-closed pattern the bead acknowledged has been refactored since filing — `required_permissions_for_op` now returns a typed `RequiredPermissions` enum with `Known(&[&str])` and `UnknownOp` variants (permissions.rs:54-71, 112-153), replacing the earlier `&'static [&'static str]` shape that used the `__unknown_space_patch_op__` magic string sentinel. The doc-comment at lines 95-102 documents the migration: 'The typed return value replaced an earlier &[&str] shape that used a magic sentinel string... that contract was load-bearing on a name no public API exposed.'

Backends now match on the enum variant directly, which is both clearer for new contributors AND removes the bus-factor risk of the sentinel-string contract. The bead's prescription ('preserve fail-closed pattern') is honored even better than the bead expected — the pattern is now typed.
